Concourse Drift.name: Concourse Drift
Concourse Drift.description: The user turns to smoke and spreads along the draft through an entire station concourse, with a thin branch down each open passage. For five minutes the user can look out of any branch and gather the whole body at any one of its tips in a turn, even a block from the starting point. A shut fire door cuts off that route. An exhaust fan pulls the smoke downwind, and the user must gather there before taking solid form. Strain: severe.
